messages:
Asha (PM): quick sync — Acme pilot wants private deploy by end of next sprint. Need a short checklist of cross-team gating so we can commit. who owns what?
Luis (Eng PM): TL;DR: product says launch criteria are: customer data encryption end-to-end, <1s median infer latency for 95% routes, + capacity for 50 concurrent sessions, and canary rollback plan.
Ken (Runtime): noted. latency target depends on model variant and quantization. we can hit <1s if we do 8-bit quant + prewarm for critical lanes. need to know which model size.
Asha (PM): they're ok with a 13B variant initially. quality must match baseline evals we shared.
Priya (Infra): infra tasks: VPC peering + VPN certs, NLB config, reserved GPU slots for dedicated pilot, storage encryption at rest. Need at least 2 weeks lead time for infra changes.
Marco (Security): KMS/HSM integration mandatory. also audit logs + SIEM forwarding. I'll need a list of threat model assumptions.
Jenna (Solutions): Acme told us they need SOC2 scoping and tenant isolation, but are flexible on canaries. they prefer a rolling canary to test quota behavior.
Noah (SRE): SLOs to track: p95 latency, p99 latency, token cost per request, error rate. also prewarm warmup script we can run during preflight.
Luis (Eng PM): actionables:
- product: confirm model + acceptance eval set (asha)
- runtime: quant profile + prewarm plan (ken)
- infra: network + reserved capacity timeline (priya)
- security: KMS + audit + threat assumptions (marco)
- SRE: SLO dashboards + rollback playbook (noah)
Asha (PM): can everyone drop an ETA in this thread by EOD today? customer expects a rough schedule by tomorrow.
Ken (Runtime): ETA: quant profile + perf numbers in 48h. prewarm script prototype in 72h.
Priya (Infra): ETA: network design and slot reservation request by EOD tomorrow, provisioning after sign-off ~7 business days.
Marco (Security): ETA: KMS integration plan + audit checklist in 3 days. I'll sync with compliance if SOC2 evidence needed.
Noah (SRE): I'll stub dashboards by tomorrow morning and add alerts for p95/p99. rollback runbook draft in 2 days.
Jenna (Solutions): I'll confirm customer SOC2 ask and share acceptance criteria doc by EOD.
Asha (PM): thanks. two quick risk calls: 1) if quant causes eval regressions we need a rollback to FP16 model variant; 2) reserved slots might delay launch.
Ken (Runtime): agreed. runtime will add automatic fallback to FP16 variant on quality regression and maintain a compatibility matrix.
Priya (Infra): if reserved slots are delayed we can initially route low-traffic canary to hosted region as fallback (with customer consent). that's a deployment policy change — needs product sign-off.
Asha (PM): noted. product sign-off: one-time fallback ok for pilot as long as it's documented and customer approves. Jenna to get approval.
Marco (Security): for HSM/KMS: do we require customer-managed keys or can we manage keys for pilot? this affects timeline.
Jenna (Solutions): Acme prefers CMK but can accept Redwood-managed keys for pilot if we promise rotation and export controls. I'll confirm.
Luis (Eng PM): rough timeline proposal (if all ETAs met):
```
Day 0-2: finalize model + eval set
Day 3-5: runtime quant + prewarm prototype
Day 3-6: infra network + slot reservation requests
Day 4-7: security KMS plan + audit prep
Day 6-9: canary + SRE dashboarding + rollback drills
Day 10: pilot launch (limited tenant traffic)
```
Noah (SRE): suggest adding a day for canary observation and a cutover decision gate before full ramp.
Asha (PM): good call — add a formal gate: "canary-stable" check with 24h observation and quality/lambda pass.
Priya (Infra): one more dependency: our GPU vendor needs a purchase order for reserved pool. estimate procurement lead time 5 business days. that will push provisioning if PO not in this sprint.
Asha (PM): okay — I'll escalate procurement now.
Ken (Runtime): blockers: we need a canonical prompt set for evals that exercise tail-latency tokens; please attach.
Asha (PM): attaching prompt_set_v2 in the next thread reply.
Jenna (Solutions): customer acceptance criteria summary:
- p95 < 1s for primary routes
- no data exfil in audit logs
- canary with 5% traffic for 24h, then decision gate
- SOC2 evidence: isolation and KMS notes
Marco (Security): adding: we need to validate crypto-at-rest during canary and capture logs for retention policy.
Luis (Eng PM): final ask: who's the single owner for the launch ticket? I propose Priya owns deployment, Asha owns signoff, and Ken owns performance.
Priya (Infra): I'm fine owning deployment orchestration.
Asha (PM): I'll own signoff and customer communication. Ken will own runtime perf.
Noah (SRE): I'll be on-call for canary window and own alerts.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: 1774323600 -> reserved-slot-provision (priya) :white_check_mark:
Asha (PM): great. next steps: everyone drop confirmation in thread when their ETA is firm. I'll collate into a one-pager for Acme. :handshake:
